p0.original: Introduction to the Impacts of Government Borrowing

p3.original: On November 8, 1965, President Lyndon B. Johnson signed The Higher Education Act of 1965 into law. With a stroke of the pen, he implemented what we know as the financial aid, work study, and student loan programs to help Americans pay for a college education. In his remarks, the President said:
p3.zh: 1965年11月8日,林登·B总统.约翰逊签署1965年高等教育法成为法律. 他用笔打一针, 执行我们所知道的 财政援助,工作学习,和学生贷款计划 帮助美国人支付大学教育费用。 主席在讲话中说:

p4.original: Here the seeds were planted from which grew my firm conviction that for the individual, education is the path to achievement and fulfillment; for the Nation, it is a path to a society that is not only free but civilized; and for the world, it is the path to peace—for it is education that places reason over force.
p4.zh: 我坚信,对个人来说,教育是取得成就和成就的道路;对国家来说,教育是通往一个不仅自由而且文明的社会的道路;对世界来说,是通往和平的道路——因为教育使理性凌驾于武力之上。

p5.original: This Act, he said, "is responsible for funding higher education for millions of Americans. It is the embodiment of the United States’ investment in ‘human capital’." Since Johnson signed the Act into law, the government has renewed it several times.
p5.zh: 他说,该法案"负责为数百万美国人的高等教育提供资金.这也是美国对“人力资本”投资的体现。 自从约翰逊将该法案签署为法律以来,政府多次更新了该法案。

p6.original: The purpose of The Higher Education Act of 1965 was to build the country’s human capital by creating educational opportunity for millions of Americans. The three criteria that the government uses to judge eligibility are income, full-time or part-time attendance, and the cost of the institution. According to education.org, in the 2011–2012 school year, over 80% of all full-time college students received some form of federal financial aid; 43% received grants; and another 41% of students aged 15–23 received federal government student loans. The budget to support financial aid has increased not only because of more enrollment, but also because of increased tuition and fees for higher education. In 2022, the government generally took an approach of increasing student aid through programs such as Pell Grant expansion, while also taking steps to ease student loan debt.
p6.zh: 1965年高等教育法的目的是通过为数百万美国人创造教育机会来建设国家的人力资本. 政府用来判断资格的三个标准是收入、全时或非全时出勤以及机构费用。 根据教育.org,2011-2012学年,80%以上的全日制大学生获得某种形式的联邦财政援助;43%获得助学金;另外41%的15至23岁学生获得联邦政府学生贷款。资助财政援助的预算增加,不仅因为入学人数增加,而且因为高等教育的学费和收费增加。2022年,政府一般采取通过Pell Grant扩展等方案增加学生援助的办法,同时也采取措施减轻学生贷款债务.

p12.original: Fiscal Policy and the Trade Balance

p13.original: Governments have many competing demands for financial support. Any spending should be tempered by fiscal responsibility and by looking carefully at the spending’s impact. When a government spends more than it collects in taxes, it runs a budget deficit. It then needs to borrow. When government borrowing becomes especially large and sustained, it can substantially reduce the financial capital available to private sector firms, as well as lead to trade imbalances and even financial crises.
p13.zh: 各国政府对财政支助有许多相互竞争的要求。任何支出都应该通过财政责任和仔细研究支出的影响来减少。 当一个政府花在税收上的钱超过它所收的,它就有一个预算赤字. 然后需要借钱。 当政府借款变得特别大和持续时,它可以大大减少私营部门公司可用的金融资本,并导致贸易失衡,甚至金融危机。

p14.original: The Government Budgets and Fiscal Policy chapter introduced the concepts of deficits and debt, as well as how a government could use fiscal policy to address recession or inflation. This chapter begins by building on the national savings and investment identity, which we first introduced in The International Trade and Capital Flows chapter, to show how government borrowing affects firms’ physical capital investment levels and trade balances. A prolonged period of budget deficits may lead to lower economic growth, in part because the funds that the government borrows to fund its budget deficits are typically no longer available for private investment. Moreover, a sustained pattern of large budget deficits can lead to disruptive economic patterns of high inflation, substantial inflows of financial capital from abroad, plummeting exchange rates, and heavy strains on a country’s banking and financial system.
p14.zh: 政府预算和财政政策一章介绍了赤字和债务的概念,以及政府如何利用财政政策解决衰退或通货膨胀问题。本章以国家储蓄和投资特征为基础,我们首先在《国际贸易和资本流动》一章中介绍了这一特征,以表明政府借贷如何影响企业的有形资本投资水平和贸易平衡。长期预算赤字可能导致经济增长下降,部分原因是政府借来弥补预算赤字的资金通常不再用于私人投资。 此外,预算赤字的持续性模式可能导致高通胀、大量国外金融资本流入、汇率暴跌、以及一国银行和金融系统的严重压力等破坏性经济模式。

p15.original: How Government Borrowing Affects Investment and the Trade Balance
p15.zh: 政府借款如何影响投资和贸易平衡

p16.original: When governments are borrowers in financial markets, there are three possible sources for the funds from a macroeconomic point of view: (1) households might save more; (2) private firms might borrow less; and (3) the additional funds for government borrowing might come from outside the country, from foreign financial investors. Let’s begin with a review of why one of these three options must occur, and then explore how interest rates and exchange rates adjust to these connections.
p16.zh: 如果政府是金融市场的借款人,从宏观经济的角度来看,资金有三个可能的来源:(1) 家庭可能节省更多;(2) 私营公司可能减少借款;(3) 政府借款的额外资金可能来自国外,来自外国投资者。 首先,让我们回顾为什么必须出现这三种选择之一,然后探讨利率和汇率如何适应这些联系。

p17.original: The National Saving and Investment Identity

p18.original: The national saving and investment identity, which we first introduced in The International Trade and Capital Flows chapter, provides a framework for showing the relationships between the sources of demand and supply in financial capital markets. The identity begins with a statement that must always hold true: the quantity of financial capital supplied in the market must equal the quantity of financial capital demanded.
p18.zh: 我们首先在《国际贸易和资本流动》一章中介绍的国家储蓄和投资特性,为显示金融资本市场供求来源之间的关系提供了一个框架。身份始于必须始终真实的陈述:市场上提供的金融资本数量必须等同于所要求的金融资本数量。

p19.original: The U.S. economy has two main sources for financial capital: private savings from inside the U.S. economy and public savings.
p19.zh: 美国经济有两大金融资本来源:美国经济内部的私人储蓄和公共储蓄.

p20.original: These include the inflow of foreign financial capital from abroad. The inflow of savings from abroad is, by definition, equal to the trade deficit, as we explained in The International Trade and Capital Flows chapter. We can write this inflow of foreign investment capital as imports (M) minus exports (X). There are also two main sources of demand for financial capital: private sector investment (I) and government borrowing. Government borrowing in any given year is equal to the budget deficit, which we can write as the difference between government spending (G) and net taxes (T). Let’s call this equation 1.
p20.zh: 这包括外国金融资本从国外流入。 正如我们在《国际贸易和资本流动》一章中解释的那样,从国外储蓄的流入按定义相当于贸易逆差。 我们可以将这种外来投资资本的流入写成进口(M)减去出口(X)。 对金融资本的需求还有两个主要来源:私营部门投资(I)和政府借贷。任何特定年份的政府借款都等于预算赤字,我们可以将预算赤字写成政府支出(G)和净税(T)之间的差额. 让我们把这叫做方程式1。

p21.original: Governments often spend more than they receive in taxes and, therefore, public savings (T – G) is negative. This causes a need to borrow money in the amount of (G – T) instead of adding to the nation’s savings. If this is the case, we can view governments as demanders of financial capital instead of suppliers. In algebraic terms, we can rewrite the national savings and investment identity like this:
p21.zh: 政府往往比其税收支出多,因此,公共储蓄(T-G)是负数。 这导致需要借钱(G-T),而不是增加国家储蓄。 如果是这样,我们可以把政府视为金融资本的需求者,而不是供应商。 用代数的术语来说,我们可以重写这样的国民储蓄和投资身份:

p22.original: Let’s call this equation 2. We must accompany a change in any part of the national saving and investment identity by offsetting changes in at least one other part of the equation because we assume that the equality of quantity supplied and quantity demanded always holds. If the government budget deficit changes, then either private saving or investment or the trade balance—or some combination of the three—must change as well.  shows the possible effects.
p22.zh: 让我们称之为方程式2。 我们必须通过至少抵消公式中另一部分的变化来配合国民储蓄和投资特性的任何部分的变化,因为我们假定供应量和要求的数量的平等地位始终保持不变。 如果政府预算赤字发生变化,那么私人储蓄或投资或贸易平衡——或三个因素的某种组合——也显示出可能的影响。

p24.original: What about Budget Surpluses and Trade Surpluses?
p24.zh: 预算盈余和贸易盈余怎么办?

However, the formula will look somewhat different if the government budget is in deficit rather than surplus or if the balance of trade is in surplus rather than deficit. For example, in 1999 and 2000, the U.S. government had budget surpluses, although the economy was still experiencing trade deficits. When the government was running budget surpluses, it was acting as a saver rather than a borrower, and supplying rather than demanding financial capital. As a result, we would write the national saving and investment identity during this time as:
p25.zh: 国民储蓄和投资身份必须始终正确,因为根据定义,金融资本市场上供应的数量和要求的数量必须始终平等。 但是,如果政府预算是赤字而不是盈余,或者贸易平衡是盈余而不是赤字,则这一公式看起来会有些不同。 例如,1999年和2000年,美国政府的预算盈余,尽管该国经济仍然面临贸易赤字。 当政府管理预算盈余时,它充当储蓄者而不是借款者,供应而不是要求金融资本。 因此,我们将在此期间将国家储蓄和投资身份写成:

p26.zh: 方程式3就叫这个注意此表达式在数学上与方程式2相同,但身份的储蓄和投资方只是翻转了方位.

p28.zh: 贸易顺差不是作为金融资本供应的一部分的贸易平衡,而是金融资本流出,离开国内经济,投资于世界其他地方。

p29.original: We assume that the point to these equations is that the national saving and investment identity always hold. When you write these relationships, it is important to engage your brain and think about what is on the supply and demand side of the financial capital market before you start your calculations.
p29.zh: 我们假设,这些方程式的要点是,国家储蓄和投资身份始终存在。 当你写这些关系时,重要的是在开始计算之前,要让大脑参与,思考金融资本市场的供求方面是什么.

p30.original: As you can see in , the Office of Management and Budget shows that the United States has consistently run budget deficits since 1977, with the exception of 1999 and 2000. What is alarming is the dramatic increase in budget deficits that has occurred since 2008, which in part reflects declining tax revenues and increased safety net expenditures due to the Great Recession. While deficits were controlled as the economy began to recover in the mid-2010s, the budget deficit increased again in 2020 during the pandemic, and forecasters expect deficits to remain high for the foreseeable future. (Recall that T is net taxes. When the government must transfer funds back to individuals for safety net expenditures like Social Security and unemployment benefits, budget deficits rise.) These deficits have implications for the future health of the U.S. economy.
p30.zh: 正如你们可以看到的那样,管理和预算办公室显示,除1999年和2000年外,美国自1977年以来一直存在预算赤字。令人震惊的是,2008年以来预算赤字急剧增加,部分反映了税收减少和由于大衰退而增加的安全网支出。 虽然随着2010年代中期经济开始复苏,赤字受到控制,但2020年,在大流行病期间,预算赤字再次增加,预测者预计,赤字在可预见的未来仍将居高不下。(回顾T是净税。) 当政府必须把资金用于社会保障和失业福利等安全网支出时,预算赤字就会增加。 )这些赤字对美国未来经济的健康产生影响。

p47.original: Fiscal Policy and the Trade Balance

p48.original: Government budget balances can affect the trade balance. As The Keynesian Perspective chapter discusses, a net inflow of foreign financial investment always accompanies a trade deficit, while a net outflow of financial investment always accompanies a trade surplus. One way to understand the connection from budget deficits to trade deficits is that when government creates a budget deficit with some combination of tax cuts or spending increases, it will increase aggregate demand in the economy, and some of that increase in aggregate demand will result in a higher level of imports. A higher level of imports, with exports remaining fixed, will cause a larger trade deficit. That means foreigners’ holdings of dollars increase as Americans purchase more imported goods. Foreigners use those dollars to invest in the United States, which leads to an inflow of foreign investment.  One possible source of funding our budget deficit is foreigners buying Treasury securities that the U.S. government sells, thus a trade deficit often accompanies a budget deficit.
p48.zh: 政府预算结余可影响贸易平衡。 正如《凯恩斯观点》一章所讨论的,外国金融投资的净流入总是伴随着贸易逆差,而金融投资的净流出则总是伴随着贸易顺差。理解预算赤字与贸易赤字之间联系的一个途径是,当政府通过减税或增加支出等措施形成预算赤字时,会增加经济的总需求,而总需求增长中的一些会导致进口水平的提高.增加进口额,使出口保持不变,将造成更大的贸易赤字。 这意味着随着美国人购买更多的进口商品,外国人持有的美元会增加。外国人使用这些美元在美国投资,这导致外国投资的流入。 我们预算赤字的一个可能资金来源是外国人购买美国政府出售的国库证券,因此贸易赤字往往伴随着预算赤字。

p50.original: In the mid-1980s, it was common to hear economists and even newspaper articles refer to the twin deficits, as the budget deficit and trade deficit both grew substantially.  shows the pattern. The federal budget deficit went from 2.6% of GDP in 1981 to 5.1% of GDP in 1985—a drop of 2.5% of GDP. Over that time, the trade deficit moved from 0.5% in 1981 to 2.9% in 1985—a drop of 2.4% of GDP. In the mid-1980s an inflow of foreign investment capital matched, the considerable increase in government borrowing, so the government budget deficit and the trade deficit moved together.
p50.zh: 在1980年代中期,经济学家甚至报纸文章都经常提到双重赤字,因为预算赤字和贸易赤字都大幅度增长。联邦预算赤字从1981年占国内生产总值的2.6%下降到1985年占国内生产总值的5.1%,下降了2.5%。在此期间,贸易逆差从1981年的0.5%下降到1985年的2.9%,下降了2.4%。1980年代中期,外来投资资本流入量相匹配,政府借款大幅增加,因此政府预算赤字和贸易赤字相继转移.

p51.original: U.S. Budget Deficits and Trade Deficits
p51.zh: 美国.预算赤字和贸易赤字

p52.original: Of course, no one should expect the budget deficit and trade deficit to move in lockstep, because the other parts of the national saving and investment identity—investment and private savings—will often change as well. In the late 1990s, for example, the government budget balance turned from deficit to surplus, but the trade deficit remained large and growing. During this time, the inflow of foreign financial investment was supporting a surge of physical capital investment by U.S. firms. In the first half of the 2000s, the budget and trade deficits again increased together, but in 2009, the budget deficit increased while the trade deficit declined. Through the 2010s, as there were bigger changes in the budget deficit, the trade deficit remained stable. The budget deficit and the trade deficits are related to each other, but they are more like cousins than twins.
p52.zh: 当然,任何人都不应期望预算赤字和贸易赤字会紧紧地移动,因为国民储蓄和投资特征的其他部分——投资和私人储蓄——也会经常发生变化。 例如,在1990年代后期,政府预算平衡从赤字转为盈余,但贸易赤字仍然很大且在增加。在此期间,外国金融投资的流入支持了美国公司实物资本投资的激增。 在2000年代的前半期,预算和贸易赤字再次一起增加,但在2009年,预算赤字增加,而贸易赤字则下降。2010年代,由于预算赤字出现较大变化,贸易赤字保持稳定。预算赤字和贸易赤字是相互关联的,但他们更像是表亲而不是双胞胎.

p54.original: Exchange rates can also help to explain why budget deficits are linked to trade deficits.  shows a situation using the exchange rate for the U.S. dollar, measured in euros. At the original equilibrium (E0), where the demand for U.S. dollars (D0) intersects with the supply of U.S. dollars (S0) on the foreign exchange market, the exchange rate is 0.9 euros per U.S. dollar and the equilibrium quantity traded in the market is $100 billion per day. Then the U.S. budget deficit rises and foreign financial investment provides the source of funds for that budget deficit.
p54.zh: 汇率还有助于解释为什么预算赤字与贸易赤字相关联。 汇率以欧元为单位,表明一种以美元汇率为单位的情况。 在最初的平衡(E0)中,对美元(D0)的需求与外汇市场上的美元(S0)供应相交,汇率为每美元0.9欧元,市场交易的平衡数量为每天1000亿美元.之后,美国的预算赤字上升,外国金融投资为这种预算赤字提供了资金来源.

p55.original: International financial investors, as a group, will demand more U.S. dollars on foreign exchange markets to purchase the U.S. government bonds, and they will supply fewer of the U.S. dollars that they already hold in these markets. Demand for U.S. dollars on the foreign exchange market shifts from D0 to D1 and the supply of U.S. dollars falls from S0 to S1. At the new equilibrium (E1), the exchange rate has appreciated to 1.05 euros per dollar while, in this example, the quantity of dollars traded remains the same.
p55.zh: 国际金融投资者作为一个集团,将对外汇市场要求更多的美元购买美国政府债券,他们供应的美元会更少,而美国在这些市场上已经持有的美元也会更少. 对外汇市场美元的需求从D0变为D1,而美元的供应从S0降到S1. 在新的平衡(E1)下,汇率升值至1.05欧元兑1美元,而在这个例子中,美元交易数量保持不变。

p57.original: A stronger exchange rate, of course, makes it more difficult for exporters to sell their goods abroad while making imports cheaper, so a trade deficit (or a reduced trade surplus) results. Thus, a budget deficit can easily result in an inflow of foreign financial capital, a stronger exchange rate, and a trade deficit.
p57.zh: 当然,汇率的加强使出口商更难在国外销售货物,同时使进口更便宜,因此贸易逆差(或贸易顺差的减少)就产生了结果。 因此,预算赤字很容易导致外国金融资本的流入、汇率的加强和贸易赤字。

p58.original: You can also imagine interest rates are driving the exchange rate appreciation. As we explained earlier in , a budget deficit increases demand in markets for domestic financial capital, raising the domestic interest rate. A higher interest rate will attract an inflow of foreign financial capital, and appreciate the exchange rate in response to the increase in demand for U.S. dollars by foreign investors and a decrease in supply of U. S. dollars. Because of higher interest rates in the United States, Americans find U.S. bonds more attractive than foreign bonds. When Americans are buying fewer foreign bonds, they are supplying fewer U.S. dollars. U.S. dollar appreciation leads to a larger trade deficit (or reduced surplus). The connections between inflows of foreign investment capital, interest rates, and exchange rates are all just different ways of drawing the same economic connections: a larger budget deficit can result in a larger trade deficit, although do not expect the connection to be one-to-one.
p58.zh: 您也可以想象利率正在推动汇率升值。 正如我们在前面解释的那样,预算赤字增加了市场对国内金融资本的需求,提高了国内利率。较高的利率将吸引外国金融资本的流入,并赞赏汇率,以应对外国投资者对美国美元需求的增加和对美国供应的减少。现值美元. 由于美国利率较高,美国人发现美国债券比外国债券更有吸引力. 当美国人购买的外国债券较少时,他们供应的美国美元也较少.美元升值导致贸易赤字增加(或顺差减少).外国投资资本流入、利率和汇率之间的关联,都是利用相同经济关联的不同方式:更大的预算赤字可能导致更大的贸易赤字,尽管并不期望这种关联是一对一的。

p59.original: From Budget Deficits to International Economic Crisis
p59.zh: 从预算赤字到国际经济危机

p60.original: We lay out step-by-step the economic story of how an outflow of international financial capital can cause a deep recession in the Exchange Rates and International Capital Flows chapter. When international financial investors decide to withdraw their funds from a country like Turkey, they increase the supply of the Turkish lira and reduce the demand for lira, depreciating the lira exchange rate. When firms and the government in a country like Turkey borrow money in international financial markets, they typically do so in stages. First, banks in Turkey borrow in a widely used currency like U.S. dollars or euros, then convert those U.S. dollars to lira, and then lend the money to borrowers in Turkey. If the lira's exchange rate value depreciates, then Turkey’s banks will find it impossible to repay the international loans that are in U.S. dollars or euros.
p60.zh: 我们逐步地讲述了国际金融资本外流如何导致汇率和国际资本流动一章严重衰退的经济故事。 当国际金融投资者决定从土耳其这样的国家提取资金时,他们会增加土耳其里拉的供给,减少对里拉的需求,从而贬值里拉汇率. 土耳其等国的公司和政府在国际金融市场上借钱时,通常会分阶段借钱。 首先,土耳其的银行以美元或欧元等广泛使用的货币借款,然后将这些美元兑换成里拉,然后将这笔钱借给土耳其的借款人. 如果里拉的汇率贬值,那么土耳其银行将发现无法偿还以美元或欧元计的国际贷款.

p61.original: The combination of less foreign investment capital and banks that are bankrupt can sharply reduce aggregate demand, which causes a deep recession. Many countries around the world have experienced this kind of recession: along with Turkey in 2002, Mexico followed this general pattern in 1995, Thailand and countries across East Asia in 1997–1998, Russia in 1998, and Argentina in 2002. In many of these countries, large government budget deficits played a role in setting the stage for the financial crisis. A moderate increase in a budget deficit that leads to a moderate increase in a trade deficit and a moderate appreciation of the exchange rate is not necessarily a cause for concern. However, beyond some point that is hard to define in advance, a series of large budget deficits can become a cause for concern among international investors.
p61.zh: 外国投资资本减少和银行破产相结合,可大幅度降低总需求,造成深度衰退。世界上许多国家都经历了这种衰退:2002年土耳其、1995年墨西哥和1997-1998年东亚各国、1998年俄罗斯和2002年阿根廷都遵循了这种总体模式。 在这些国家中,许多国家的政府预算赤字巨大,为金融危机铺平了道路。预算赤字适度增加,导致贸易赤字适度增加,汇率适度升值,不一定令人关切。 然而,除了难以事先确定的某一点外,一系列巨额预算赤字可能成为国际投资者关注的一个问题。

p62.original: One reason for concern is that extremely large budget deficits mean that aggregate demand may shift so far to the right as to cause high inflation. The example of Turkey is a situation where very large budget deficits brought inflation rates well into double digits. In addition, very large budget deficits at some point begin to raise a fear that the government would not repay the borrowing. In the last 100 years, the government of Turkey has been unable to pay its debts and defaulted on its loans four times. Over the past 175 years, Brazil’s government has been unable to pay its debts and defaulted on its loans seven times; Venezuela, nine times; and Argentina, five times. The risk of high inflation or a default on repaying international loans will worry international investors, since both factors imply that the rate of return on their investments in that country may end up lower than expected. If international investors start withdrawing the funds from a country rapidly, the scenario of less investment, a depreciated exchange rate, widespread bank failure, and deep recession can occur. The following Clear It Up feature explains other impacts of large deficits.
p62.zh: 令人关切的一个原因是,预算赤字极高,这意味着总需求可能迄今转向造成高通货膨胀的正确方向。 土耳其的例子就是,非常庞大的预算赤字使通货膨胀率大大达到两位数。 此外,相当大的预算赤字在某个时候开始引起人们担心政府不会偿还借款. 在过去的100年里,土耳其政府一直无力偿还债务,并四次拖欠贷款. 巴西政府无法偿还债务, 拖欠贷款7次; 委内瑞拉9次; 阿根廷5次。 国际投资者担心通货膨胀高或拖欠偿还国际贷款的风险,因为这两个因素都意味着他们在该国投资的回报率可能低于预期。 如果国际投资者开始迅速从一个国家撤出资金,投资减少、汇率贬值、银行大面积倒闭和深度衰退等情况就可能发生。 以下的Clear It Up特征解释了巨额赤字的其他影响.

p63.original: What are the risks of chronic large deficits in the United States?
p63.zh: 美国长期巨额赤字的风险是什么?

p64.original: If a government runs large budget deficits for a sustained period of time, what can go wrong? According to a recent Brookings Institution report, a key risk of a large budget deficit is that government debt may grow too high compared to the country’s GDP growth. As debt grows, the national savings rate will decline, leaving less available in financial capital for private investment. The impact of chronically large budget deficits is as follows:
p64.zh: 如果一个政府长期存在巨额预算赤字,那会有什么问题呢? 根据布鲁金斯研究所最近的一份报告,预算赤字巨大的一个关键风险是,政府债务可能比该国国内生产总值增长高。 随着债务的增长,国民储蓄率将下降,使可用于私人投资的金融资本减少。长期巨额预算赤字的影响如下:

p65.original: As the population ages, there will be an increasing demand for government services that may cause higher government deficits. Government borrowing and its interest payments will pull resources away from domestic investment in human capital and physical capital that is essential to economic growth.
p65.zh: 随着人口的老化,对政府服务的需求将不断增加,这可能导致政府赤字增加。 政府借贷及其利息支付将使资源从国内人力资本和有形资本投资中抽走,而这种投资对经济增长至关重要。

p66.original: Interest rates may start to rise so that the cost of financing government debt will rise as well, creating pressure on the government to reduce its budget deficits through spending cuts and tax increases. These steps will be politically painful, and they will also have a contractionary effect on aggregate demand in the economy.
p66.zh: 利率可能开始上升,以便政府债务融资成本也会上升,从而对政府施加压力,通过削减开支和增加税收来减少预算赤字。 这些步骤在政治上将是痛苦的,它们也会对经济的总需求产生收缩效应。

p67.original: Rising percentage of debt to GDP will create uncertainty in the financial and global markets that might cause a country to resort to inflationary tactics to reduce the real value of the debt outstanding. This will decrease real wealth and damage confidence in the country’s ability to manage its spending. After all, if the government has borrowed at a fixed interest rate of, say, 5%, and it lets inflation rise above that 5%, then it will effectively be able to repay its debt at a negative real interest rate.
p67.zh: 债务占国内生产总值的百分比上升,将造成金融和全球市场的不确定性,从而可能使一个国家采取通货膨胀策略,降低未偿债务的实际价值。 这将减少真正的财富,并破坏人们对该国管理开支的能力的信心。毕竟,如果政府以5%的固定利率借款,并且让通货膨胀超过5%,那么它就能有效地以负实际利率偿还债务。

p68.original: The conventional reasoning suggests that the relationship between sustained deficits that lead to high levels of government debt and long-term growth is negative. How significant this relationship is, how big an issue it is compared to other macroeconomic issues, and the direction of causality, is less clear.
p68.zh: 传统的推理表明,导致高额政府债务的持续赤字与长期增长之间的关系是负的。这种关系的重要性如何,与其他宏观经济问题相比,一个问题有多大,因果关系的方向如何,都不太明确。

p69.original: What remains important to acknowledge is that the relationship between debt and growth is negative and that for some countries, the relationship may be stronger than in others. It is also important to acknowledge the direction of causality: does high debt cause slow growth, slow growth cause high debt, or are both high debt and slow growth the result of third factors? In our analysis, we have argued simply that high debt causes slow growth. There may be more to this debate than we have space to discuss here.
p69.zh: 必须承认的是,债务与增长之间的关系是负的,对一些国家来说,这种关系可能比其他国家更牢固。还必须承认因果关系的方向:高债务是否导致缓慢增长,缓慢增长导致高债务,还是高债务和缓慢增长都是第三个因素造成的? 在我们的分析中,我们只是认为,高额债务导致增长缓慢。这场辩论可能比我们这里有讨论的余地还要多。

p70.original: Using Fiscal Policy to Address Trade Imbalances
p70.zh: 利用财政政策解决贸易不平衡问题

p71.original: If a nation is experiencing the inflow of foreign investment capital associated with a trade deficit because foreign investors are making long-term direct investments in firms, there may be no substantial reason for concern. After all, many low-income nations around the world would welcome direct investment by multinational firms that ties them more closely into the global networks of production and distribution of goods and services. In this case, the inflows of foreign investment capital and the trade deficit are attracted by the opportunities for a good rate of return on private sector investment in an economy.
p71.zh: 如果一个国家由于外国投资者对公司进行长期直接投资而面临与贸易逆差有关的外国投资资本流入,那么就可能没有实质性的理由引起关注。毕竟,全世界许多低收入国家都欢迎跨国公司进行直接投资,使它们更紧密地与全球货物和服务生产和分销网络联系起来。 在这种情况下,吸引外国投资资本流入和贸易逆差的,是私营部门投资在经济中收益率高的机会。

p72.original: However, governments should beware of a sustained pattern of high budget deficits and high trade deficits. The danger arises in particular when the inflow of foreign investment capital is not funding long-term physical capital investment by firms, but instead is short-term portfolio investment in government bonds. When inflows of foreign financial investment reach high levels, foreign financial investors will be on the alert for any reason to fear that the country’s exchange rate may decline or the government may be unable to repay what it has borrowed on time. Just as a few falling rocks can trigger an avalanche; a relatively small piece of bad news about an economy can trigger an enormous outflow of short-term financial capital.
p72.zh: 然而,政府应注意预算赤字高和贸易赤字高的持续模式。特别是当外国投资资本的流入不是为公司的长期实物资本投资提供资金,而是对政府债券的短期证券投资时,就会产生这种危险。 当外国金融投资的流入量达到高水平时,外国金融投资者会因担心国家的汇率可能下降或政府可能无法及时偿还其借款而处于戒备状态. 正如几块落石会引发雪崩一样;关于一个经济体的相对较小的坏消息会引发短期金融资本的大量外流。

p73.original: Reducing a nation’s budget deficit will not always be a successful method of reducing its trade deficit, because other elements of the national saving and investment identity, like private saving or investment, may change instead. In those cases when the budget deficit is the main cause of the trade deficit, governments should take steps to reduce their budget deficits, lest they make their economy vulnerable to a rapid outflow of international financial capital that could bring a deep recession.
p73.zh: 减少一国的预算赤字并不总是减少其贸易赤字的成功方法,因为国民储蓄和投资身份的其他要素,如私人储蓄或投资,可能会发生变化。 在预算赤字是贸易赤字的主要原因的情况下,各国政府应采取步骤减少预算赤字,以免使其经济易受国际金融资本迅速外流的影响,从而可能带来深度衰退。

p75.original: The government need not balance its budget every year. However, a sustained pattern of large budget deficits over time risks causing several negative macroeconomic outcomes: a shift to the right in aggregate demand that causes an inflationary increase in the price level; crowding out private investment in physical capital in a way that slows down economic growth; and creating a dependence on inflows of international portfolio investment which can sometimes turn into outflows of foreign financial investment that can be injurious to a macroeconomy.
p75.zh: 政府不需要每年平衡预算。 然而,长期预算赤字的持续模式可能导致若干负的宏观经济结果:向总需求右倾转移,导致物价水平的通胀上升;挤出对有形资本的私人投资,以减缓经济增长;以及造成对国际证券投资流入的依赖,有时可能变成外国金融投资的外流,从而损害宏观经济。

p77.original: In the late 1990s, the U.S. government moved from a budget deficit to a budget surplus and the trade deficit in the U.S. economy grew substantially. Using the national saving and investment identity, what can you say about the direction in which saving and/or investment must have changed in this economy?
p77.zh: 1990年代后期,美国政府从预算赤字转为预算盈余,美国经济的贸易赤字大幅增长.利用国家储蓄和投资特性,你对储蓄和(或)投资在这一经济中必须改变的方向能说什么?

p78.original: In this case, the national saving and investment identity is written in this way:
p78.zh: 在这种情况下,国民储蓄和投资身份就是用这种方式写成的:

p79.original: The increase in the government budget surplus and the increase in the trade deficit both increased the supply of financial capital. If investment in physical capital remained unchanged, then private savings must go down, and if savings remained unchanged, then investment must go up. In fact, both effects happened; that is, in the late 1990s, in the U.S. economy, savings declined and investment rose.
p79.zh: 政府预算盈余的增加和贸易赤字的增加都增加了金融资本的供应。 如果对实物资本的投资保持不变,那么私人储蓄就必须减少,如果储蓄保持不变,那么投资就必须增加。 事实上,这两种影响都发生了;也就是说,在1990年代末,在美国经济中,储蓄下降,投资增加。

p81.original: Under what conditions will a larger budget deficit cause a trade deficit?
p81.zh: 在什么条件下,更大的预算赤字会导致贸易赤字?

p83.original: Explain how a shift from a government budget deficit to a budget surplus might affect the exchange rate.
p83.zh: 解释从政府预算赤字向预算盈余的转变会如何影响汇率。

p84.original: Describe how a plan for reducing the government deficit might affect a college student, a young professional, and a middle-income family.
p84.zh: 说明减少政府赤字的计划对大学生、年轻专业人员和中等收入家庭有何影响。

p86.original: Sketch a diagram of how a budget deficit causes a trade deficit. (Hint: Begin with what will happen to the exchange rate when foreigners demand more U.S. government debt.)
p86.zh: 绘制预算赤字如何导致贸易赤字的图表。(提示:从外国人要求美国更多政府债务时汇率会怎样开始.

p87.original: Sketch a diagram of how sustained budget deficits cause low economic growth.
p87.zh: 勾勒出一个图表,说明持续的预算赤字如何导致低经济增长。

p88.original: Assume that the newly independent government of Tanzania employed you in 1964. Now free from British rule, the Tanzanian parliament has decided that it will spend 10 million shillings on schools, roads, and healthcare for the year. You estimate that the net taxes for the year are eight million shillings. The government will finance the difference by selling 10-year government bonds at 12% interest per year. Parliament must add the interest on outstanding bonds to government expenditure each year. Assume that Parliament places additional taxes to finance this increase in government expenditure so the gap between government spending is always two million. If the school, road, and healthcare budget are unchanged, compute the value of the accumulated debt in 10 years.
p88.zh: 假设坦桑尼亚新独立的政府于1964年雇用你。坦桑尼亚议会决定今年将花费1 000万先令用于学校、道路和医疗。 你估计当年的净税是八百万先令. 政府将以每年12%的利息出售10年期的政府债券来资助这一差额.议会必须每年将未偿债券的利息加到政府支出中.假设议会为政府支出的增加额外征税,因此政府支出之间的差额总是200万。 如果学校、道路和保健预算不变,则计算十年内累积债务的价值。

p92.original: How Government Borrowing Affects Private Saving
p92.zh: 政府借款如何影响私人储蓄

p93.original: A change in government budgets may impact private saving. Imagine that people watch government budgets and adjust their savings accordingly. For example, whenever the government runs a budget deficit, people might reason: “Well, a higher budget deficit means that I’m just going to owe more taxes in the future to pay off all that government borrowing, so I’ll start saving now.” If the government runs budget surpluses, people might reason: “With these budget surpluses (or lower budget deficits), interest rates are falling, so that saving is less attractive. Moreover, with a budget surplus the country will be able to afford a tax cut sometime in the future. I won’t bother saving as much now.”
p93.zh: 政府预算的变动可能影响私人储蓄。想象一下,人民看好政府预算,相应调整储蓄. 比如,每当政府出现预算赤字时,人们可能会提出理由 : “ 那么,更高的预算赤字意味着我将来将欠更多的税来偿还所有政府借款,因此我现在就开始储蓄。 ”如果政府出现预算盈余,人们可能会提出理由 : “ 有了这些预算盈余(或更低的预算赤字),利率就会下降,这样储蓄就不那么有吸引力了。 ” 此外,如果预算有盈余,该国将来一定能够减少税收。 我不会再花那么多钱储蓄了。

p94.original: The theory that rational private households might shift their saving to offset government saving or borrowing is known as Ricardian equivalence because the idea has intellectual roots in the writings of the early nineteenth-century economist David Ricardo (1772–1823). If Ricardian equivalence holds completely true, then in the national saving and investment identity, any change in budget deficits or budget surpluses would be completely offset by a corresponding change in private saving. As a result, changes in government borrowing would have no effect at all on either physical capital investment or trade balances.
p94.zh: 理性的私人家庭可能转移储蓄以抵消政府储蓄或借贷的理论被称为Ricardian等价,因为这个思想在十九世纪早期经济学家大卫·里卡多(1772–1823)的著作中有着知识根基. 如果Ricardian等值是完全真实的,那么在国家储蓄和投资特征中,预算赤字或预算盈余的任何变化都将被私人储蓄的相应变化完全抵消. 因此,政府借款的变化对实物资本投资或贸易平衡都没有任何影响。

p95.original: In practice, the private sector only sometimes and partially adjusts its savings behavior to offset government budget deficits and surpluses.  shows the patterns of U.S. government budget deficits and surpluses and the rate of private saving—which includes saving by both households and firms—since 1980. The connection between the two is not at all obvious. In the mid-1980s, for example, government budget deficits were quite large, but there is no corresponding surge of private saving. However, when budget deficits turn to surpluses in the late 1990s, there is a simultaneous decline in private saving. When budget deficits got very large in 2008 and 2009, there was another a rise in saving. When the deficit increased again in 2020, saving jumped up as well. A variety of statistical studies based on the U.S. experience suggests that when government borrowing increases by $1, private saving rises by about 30 cents. A World Bank study from the late 1990s, looking at government budgets and private saving behavior in countries around the world, found a similar result.
p95.zh: 在实践中,私营部门只是有时和部分地调整其储蓄行为,以抵消政府预算赤字和盈余。 这表明1980年以来美国政府预算赤字和盈余的模式以及私人储蓄率,包括家庭和公司的储蓄率。两者之间的联系根本不是显而易见的。 例如,在1980年代中期,政府预算赤字相当大,但私人储蓄没有相应激增。 然而,当预算赤字在1990年代末转为盈余时,私人储蓄同时减少。2008年和2009年,预算赤字非常大,储蓄再次增加。 当2020年赤字再次增加时,储蓄也猛增。 根据美国经验进行的各种统计研究表明,当政府借款增加1美元时,私人储蓄增加约30美分.1990年代末期世界银行的一项研究,研究了世界各国的政府预算和私人储蓄行为,发现了类似的结果.

p96.original: U.S. Budget Deficits and Private Savings
p96.zh: 美国.预算赤字和私人储蓄

p97.original: Private saving does increase to some extent when governments run large budget deficits, and private saving falls when governments reduce deficits or run large budget surpluses. However, the offsetting effects of private saving compared to government borrowing are much less than one-to-one. In addition, this effect can vary a great deal from country to country, from time to time, and over the short and the long run.
p97.zh: 当政府出现大量预算赤字时,私人储蓄确实有一定程度的增加,而当政府减少赤字或出现大量预算盈余时,私人储蓄会下降。 然而,私人储蓄与政府借贷相比,其抵消效应远远低于一对一。 此外,这种效果因国而异,时而异,在短期和长期之间也有很大不同.

p98.original: If the funding for a larger budget deficit comes from international financial investors, then a trade deficit may accompany a budget deficit. In some countries, this pattern of twin deficits has set the stage for international financial investors first to send their funds to a country and cause an appreciation of its exchange rate and then to pull their funds out and cause a depreciation of the exchange rate and a financial crisis as well. It depends on whether funding comes from international financial investors.
p98.zh: 如果较大预算赤字的资金来自国际金融投资者,那么,贸易赤字可能伴随着预算赤字。 在一些国家,这种双重赤字模式为国际金融投资者先将资金汇往一个国家,导致其汇率升值,然后将其资金抽出,造成汇率贬值和金融危机。 这取决于资金是否来自国际金融投资者。

p100.original: The theory of Ricardian equivalence holds that changes in private saving will offset changes in government borrowing or saving. Thus, greater private saving will offset higher budget deficits, while greater private borrowing will offset larger budget surpluses. If the theory holds true, then changes in government borrowing or saving would have no effect on private investment in physical capital or on the trade balance. However, empirical evidence suggests that the theory holds true only partially.
p100.zh: Ricardian等值理论认为,私人储蓄的变化将抵消政府借贷或储蓄的变化. 因此,私人储蓄的增加将抵消预算赤字的增加,而私人借贷的增加将抵消预算盈余的增加。 如果这一理论成立,那么政府借贷或储蓄的变化对实物资本的私人投资或贸易平衡不会产生影响。 然而,实证证据表明,该理论仅部分属实.

p102.original: Imagine an economy in which Ricardian equivalence holds. This economy has a budget deficit of 50, a trade deficit of 20, private savings of 130, and investment of 100. If the budget deficit rises to 70, how are the other terms in the national saving and investment identity affected?
p102.zh: 想象一下,一个经济里 瑞加的等价。 这一经济的预算赤字为50,贸易赤字为20,私人储蓄为130,投资为100. 如果预算赤字增加到70,国民储蓄和投资特征中的其他术语会受到什么影响?

p103.original: Ricardian equivalence means that private saving changes to offset exactly any changes in the government budget. So, if the deficit increases by 20, private saving increases by 20 as well, and the trade deficit and the budget deficit will not change from their original levels. The original national saving and investment identity is written below. Notice that if any change in the (G – T) term is offset by a change in the S term, then the other terms do not change. So if (G – T) rises by 20, then S must also increase by 20.
p103.zh: Ricardian等值是指私人储蓄的变动,以抵消政府预算的任何变动。 因此,如果赤字增加20,私人储蓄也增加20,贸易赤字和预算赤字不会从原来的水平上改变.国家储蓄和投资的原始身份记载如下。通知,如果(G-T)术语的任何变化被S术语的改变所抵消,则其他术语不会改变。 因此,如果(G-T)增加20,那么S也必须增加20.

p105.zh: 瑞加地等价理论是什么?

p106.original: What does the concept of rationality have to do with Ricardian equivalence?
p106.zh: 理性的概念与Ricardian等同有什么关系?

p108.original: Explain whether or not you agree with the premise of the Ricardian equivalence theory that rational people might reason: “Well, a higher budget deficit (surplus) means that I’m just going to owe more (less) taxes in the future to pay off all that government borrowing, so I’ll start saving (spending) now.” Why or why not?
p108.zh: 解释一下你是否同意理性人士可能有理由的Ricardian等值理论的前提 : “ 那么,更高的预算赤字(盈余)意味着我将来只欠更多(更少)的税来还清所有的政府借款,所以我现在就开始储蓄(支出 ) 。 ”为什么或者为什么不呢?

p111.original: Fiscal Policy, Investment, and Economic Growth
p111.zh: 财政政策、投资和经济增长

p112.original: The underpinnings of economic growth are investments in physical capital, human capital, and technology, all set in an economic environment where firms and individuals can react to the incentives provided by well-functioning markets and flexible prices. Government borrowing can reduce the financial capital available for private firms to invest in physical capital. However, government spending can also encourage certain elements of long-term growth, such as spending on roads or water systems, on education, or on research and development that creates new technology.
p112.zh: 经济增长的基础是对有形资本、人力资本和技术的投资,所有投资都设定在一种经济环境中,在这种环境中,公司和个人可以对运作良好的市场和灵活价格提供的刺激措施作出反应。 政府借贷可减少私人公司投资于有形资本的金融资本。 然而,政府开支也可以鼓励某些长期增长要素,例如用于道路或供水系统、教育或用于创造新技术的研发方面的开支。

p114.original: A larger budget deficit will increase demand for financial capital. If private saving and the trade balance remain the same, then less financial capital will be available for private investment in physical capital. When government borrowing soaks up available financial capital and leaves less for private investment in physical capital, economists call the result crowding out.
p114.zh: 更大的预算赤字将增加对金融资本的需求。 如果私人储蓄和贸易平衡保持不变,那么可用于私人实物资本投资的金融资本就会减少。 当政府借款淹没了现有的金融资本,并留给私人对有形资本的投资较少时,经济学家称结果被挤出.

p115.original: To understand the potential impact of crowding out, consider the U.S. economy's situation before the exceptional circumstances of the recession that started in late 2007. In 2005, for example, the budget deficit was roughly 3% of GDP. Private investment by firms in the U.S. economy has hovered in the range of 14% to 18% of GDP in recent decades. However, in any given year, roughly half of U.S. investment in physical capital just replaces machinery and equipment that has worn out or become technologically obsolete. Only about half represents an increase in the total quantity of physical capital in the economy. Investment in new physical capital in any year is about 7% to 9% of GDP. In this situation, even U.S. budget deficits in the range of 3% of GDP can potentially crowd out a substantial share of new investment spending. Conversely, a smaller budget deficit (or an increased budget surplus) increases the pool of financial capital available for private investment.
p115.zh: 为了了解挤出的潜在影响,在2007年末开始的经济衰退的特殊情况之前,先考虑一下美国经济的情况. 例如,2005年的预算赤字约占国内生产总值的3%。近几十年来,公司在美国经济中的私人投资徘徊在国内生产总值的14%至18%之间。 然而,在任何一年中,美国有形资本投资的大约一半只是更换了已经过时或技术上已经过时的机械和设备。 只有大约一半是经济中实物资本总量的增加。任何一年对新的实物资本的投资都约占国内生产总值的7%至9%。 在这种情况下,即使是占GDP3%的美国预算赤字也可能挤占新投资支出的很大一部分。 相反,预算赤字减少(或预算盈余增加),增加了可用于私人投资的金融资本。

p116.original: Visit this website to view the “U.S. Debt Clock.”
p116.zh: 访问该网站查看“U.S.债务时钟。”

p117.original: shows the patterns of U.S. budget deficits and private investment since 1980. If greater government deficits lead to less private investment in physical capital, and reduced government deficits or budget surpluses lead to more investment in physical capital, these two lines should move up and down simultaneously. This pattern occurred in the late 1990s and early 2000s. The U.S. federal budget went from a deficit of 2.2% of GDP in 1995 to a budget surplus of 2.4% of GDP in 2000—a swing of 4.6% of GDP. From 1995 to 2000, private investment in physical capital rose from 15% to 18% of GDP—a rise of 3% of GDP. Then, when the U.S. government again started running budget deficits in the early 2000s, less financial capital became available for private investment, and the rate of private investment fell back to about 15% of GDP by 2003. However, in more recent years, in the 2010s after the economy recovered from the Great Recession, private investment as a share of GDP increased even as deficits slightly worsened, especially around 2016. And while the deficit increased substantially in 2020, private investment as a share of GDP did not.
p117.zh: 显示了1980年以来美国的预算赤字和私人投资的格局。 如果政府赤字增加导致对有形资本的私人投资减少,政府赤字或预算盈余减少导致对有形资本的投资增加,那么这两条线应该同时上下移动. 这种模式发生在1990年代末和2000年代初。 美国联邦预算从1995年占国内生产总值2.2%的赤字变为2000年占国内生产总值2.4%的预算顺差——占国内生产总值4.6%的波动。 从1995年到2000年,对实物资本的私人投资从占国内生产总值的15%增加到18%,即占国内生产总值的3%。之后,当美国政府在2000年代初再次开始经营预算赤字时,私人投入的金融资本减少,到2003年私人投资率回落到占GDP的15%左右. 然而,近年来,2010年代,经济从大衰退中复苏之后,私人投资在国内生产总值中的份额有所增加,尽管赤字略有恶化,特别是在2016年左右。 虽然赤字在2020年大幅增加,但私人投资在国内生产总值中的份额却没有增加。

p118.original: U.S. Budget Deficits/Surpluses and Private Investment
p118.zh: 美国.预算赤字/盈余和私人投资

p119.original: This argument does not claim that a government's budget deficits will exactly shadow its national rate of private investment; after all, we must account for private saving and inflows of foreign financial investment. In the mid-1980s, for example, government budget deficits increased substantially without a corresponding drop off in private investment. In 2009, nonresidential private fixed investment dropped by $300 billion from its previous level of $1,941 billion in 2008, primarily because, during a recession, firms lack both the funds and the incentive to invest. Investment growth between 2009 and 2014 averaged approximately 5.9% to $2,210.5 billion—only slightly above its 2008 level, according to the Bureau of Economic Analysis. During that same period, interest rates dropped from 3.94% to less than a quarter percent as the Federal Reserve took dramatic action to prevent a depression by increasing the money supply through lowering short-term interest rates. The "crowding out" of private investment due to government borrowing to finance expenditures appears to have been suspended after the Great Recession.
p119.zh: 这一论点并不声称政府的预算赤字会完全掩盖其国内私人投资率;毕竟,我们必须对私人储蓄和外国金融投资的流入作出解释。 例如,1980年代中期,政府预算赤字大幅增加,私人投资没有相应减少。2009年,非居民私人固定投资比2008年的19.410亿美元减少了3 000亿美元,主要原因是在经济衰退期间,公司既缺乏资金,也缺乏投资的动力。 根据经济分析局的资料,2009年至2014年的投资增长平均约为5.9%,达到22,105亿美元,仅略高于2008年的水平。在同一期间,随着联邦储备委员会采取戏剧性行动,通过降低短期利率增加货币供应,防止萧条,利率从3.94%下降到不到四分之一。民营投资因政府借款资助支出而"挤出",似乎在大衰退后被暂停.

p121.original: Assume that government borrowing of substantial amounts will have an effect on the quantity of private investment. How will this affect interest rates in financial markets? In , the original equilibrium (E0) where the demand curve (D0) for financial capital intersects with the supply curve (S0) occurs at an interest rate of 5% and an equilibrium quantity equal to 20% of GDP. However, as the government budget deficit increases, the demand curve for financial capital shifts from D0 to D1. The new equilibrium (E1) occurs at an interest rate of 6% and an equilibrium quantity of 21% of GDP.
p121.zh: 假定政府大量借款将对私人投资的数量产生影响。这会如何影响金融市场的利率? 在 中,金融资本需求曲线(D0)与供应曲线(S0)相交的原始均衡(E0)以5%的利率发生,均衡数量等于GDP的20%. 然而,随着政府预算赤字的增加,对金融资本的需求曲线从D0转向D1.新的平衡(E1)以6%的利率和21%的国内生产总值的平衡数量出现。

p123.original: A survey of economic studies on the connection between government borrowing and interest rates in the U.S. economy suggests that an increase of 1% in the budget deficit will lead to a rise in interest rates of between 0.5 and 1.0%, other factors held equal. In turn, a higher interest rate tends to discourage firms from making physical capital investments. One reason government budget deficits crowd out private investment, therefore, is the increase in interest rates. There are, however, economic studies that show a limited connection between the two (at least in the United States), but as the budget deficit grows, the dangers of rising interest rates become more real.
p123.zh: 对美国政府借贷与利率之间关系的经济研究的调查表明,预算赤字增加1%将导致利率上升0.5%至1.0%,其他因素持平.反过来,较高的利率往往会阻碍公司进行实际资本投资。 因此,政府预算赤字排挤私人投资的一个原因是利率上升。 然而,有些经济研究表明两者之间的联系有限(至少在美国),但随着预算赤字的增长,利率上升的危险变得更加真实.

p124.original: At this point, you may wonder about the Federal Reserve. After all, can the Federal Reserve not use expansionary monetary policy to reduce interest rates, or in this case, to prevent interest rates from rising? This useful question emphasizes the importance of considering how fiscal and monetary policies work in relation to each other. Imagine a central bank faced with a government that is running large budget deficits, causing a rise in interest rates and crowding out private investment. If the budget deficits are increasing aggregate demand when the economy is already producing near potential GDP, threatening an inflationary increase in price levels, the central bank may react with a contractionary monetary policy. In this situation, the higher interest rates from the government borrowing would be made even higher by contractionary monetary policy, and the government borrowing might crowd out a great deal of private investment.
p124.zh: 此时此刻,你可能会对联邦储备感到疑惑.毕竟,美联储能否不使用扩张性货币政策来降低利率,或者在此情况下防止利率上升? 这个有用的问题强调了考虑财政和货币政策如何相互配合的重要性。想象一下,一个中央银行正面临一个预算赤字庞大的政府,导致利率上升和私人投资被挤出。 如果预算赤字在经济已经产生接近潜在国内总产值、威胁物价水平的通货膨胀上升时总需求正在增加,中央银行可能会采取收缩性货币政策。 在这种情况下,政府借款的较高利率将因收缩性货币政策而变得更加高,政府借款可能挤出大量私人投资.

p125.original: Alternatively, if the budget deficits are increasing aggregate demand when the economy is producing substantially less than potential GDP, an inflationary increase in the price level is not much of a danger and the central bank might react with expansionary monetary policy. In this situation, higher interest rates from government borrowing would be largely offset by lower interest rates from expansionary monetary policy, and there would be little crowding out of private investment.
p125.zh: 或者,如果预算赤字在经济生产量大大低于潜在国内总产值时增加总需求,价格水平的通货膨胀上升并不大为危险,中央银行可能会对扩张性货币政策作出反应。 在这种情况下,政府借贷利率的提高将在很大程度上被扩张性货币政策利率的降低所抵消,私人投资很少被挤出。

p126.original: However, even a central bank cannot erase the overall message of the national savings and investment identity. If government borrowing rises, then private investment must fall, or private saving must rise, or the trade deficit must rise. By reacting with contractionary or expansionary monetary policy, the central bank can only help to determine which of these outcomes is likely.
p126.zh: 然而,即使是中央银行也不能抹去国家储蓄和投资特征的总体信息。 如果政府借贷增加,那么私人投资就必须减少,或者私人储蓄必须增加,或者贸易赤字必须增加。中央银行通过采取收缩或扩张性货币政策作出反应,只能帮助确定这些结果中哪些是可能的。

p128.original: Government can invest in physical capital directly: roads and bridges; water supply and sewers; seaports and airports; schools and hospitals; plants that generate electricity, like hydroelectric dams or windmills; telecommunications facilities; and military weapons. In 2021, the United States spent about $146 billion on transportation, including highways, mass transit, and airports.  shows the federal government's total outlay for 2021 for major public physical capital investment in the United States. We have omitted physical capital related to the military or to residences where people live from this table, because the focus here is on public investments that have a direct effect on raising output in the private sector.
p128.zh: 政府可直接投资于有形资本:道路和桥梁;供水和下水道;海港和机场;学校和医院;发电厂,如水力发电坝或风车;电信设施;以及军用武器。2021年,美国花费了约1,460亿美元用于交通,包括高速公路,公共交通,以及机场. 2021年,美国主要公共实物资本投资的联邦政府总开支显示. 我们省略了与军事有关的有形资本,或与人们居住的住宅有关的有形资本,因为这里的重点是对提高私营部门产出有直接影响的公共投资。

p129.original: Grants for Major Physical Capital Investment, 2014 and 2021, in $ Millions
p129.zh: 2014年和2021年主要实物资本投资赠款(单位:百万美元)

p142.original: Education, training, employment, and social services
p142.zh: 教育、培训、就业和社会服务

p151.original: Public physical capital investment of this sort can increase the economy's output and productivity. An economy with reliable roads and electricity will be able to produce more. However, it is hard to quantify how much government investment in physical capital will benefit the economy, because government responds to political as well as economic incentives. When a firm makes an investment in physical capital, it is subject to the discipline of the market: If it does not receive a positive return on investment, the firm may lose money or even go out of business.
p151.zh: 这类公共实物资本投资可以提高经济的产出和生产力。 一个拥有可靠道路和电力的经济将能够生产更多的产品。 然而,很难量化政府对有形资本的投资将给经济带来多少好处,因为政府对政治和经济刺激措施作出了反应。企业进行实物资本投资时,要遵守市场纪律:如果企业得不到投资的正收益,企业可能会亏损,甚至退出营业.

p152.original: In some cases, lawmakers make investments in physical capital as a way of spending money in key politicians' districts. The result may be unnecessary roads or office buildings. Even if a project is useful and necessary, it might be done in a way that is excessively costly, because local contractors who make campaign contributions to politicians appreciate the extra business. Alternatively, governments sometimes do not make the investments they should because a decision to spend on infrastructure does not need to just make economic sense. It must be politically popular as well. Managing public investment cost-effectively can be difficult.
p152.zh: 在某些情况下,立法者对实物资本进行投资,作为在关键政治家地区花钱的一种方式。 结果可能是不必要的道路或办公楼。 即使一个项目是有用和必要的,但这样做可能代价过高,因为向政治家提供竞选捐款的当地承包商赞赏额外业务。 或者,政府有时不进行它们应该进行的投资,因为决定花费在基础设施上并不需要仅仅经济合理。 它也必须在政治上很受欢迎。以成本效益高的方式管理公共投资可能很困难。

p153.original: If a government decides to finance an investment in public physical capital with higher taxes or lower government spending in other areas, it need not worry that it is directly crowding out private investment. Indirectly however, higher household taxes could cut down on the level of private savings available and have a similar effect. If a government decides to finance an investment in public physical capital by borrowing, it may end up increasing the quantity of public physical capital at the cost of crowding out investment in private physical capital, which could be more beneficial to the economy.
p153.zh: 如果政府决定为公共有形资本投资提供资金,而其他地区的税收较高或政府开支较低,则政府不必担心直接排挤私人投资。 然而,间接地,较高的家庭税会降低私人储蓄的水平,并产生类似的效果。 如果政府决定通过借贷为公共实物资本投资融资,则最终可能会增加公共实物资本的数量,而代价是排挤私人实物资本投资,这可能会对经济更有利.

p155.original: In most countries, the government plays a large role in society's investment in human capital through the education system. A highly educated and skilled workforce contributes to a higher rate of economic growth. For the low-income nations of the world, additional investment in human capital seems likely to increase productivity and growth. For the United States, critics have raised tough questions about how much increases in government spending on education will improve the actual level of education.
p155.zh: 在大多数国家,政府在社会通过教育系统对人力资本的投资中发挥着很大的作用.受过高等教育的熟练劳动力有助于提高经济增长率。 对世界低收入国家来说,对人力资本的额外投资似乎有可能提高生产力和增长。 对美国来说,批评家们提出了关于政府教育支出增加多少将提高实际教育水平的严酷问题.

p156.original: Among economists, discussions of education reform often begin with some uncomfortable facts. As  shows, total federal spending in the U.S. for kindergarten through grade 12 (K–12) increased substantially in nominal dollars through 2010, declined slightly in 2011 and 2012, and began rising again after that through 2020. However, as measured by standardized tests like the SAT, the level of student academic achievement has barely budged in recent decades. On international tests, U.S. students lag behind students from many other countries. (Of course, test scores are an imperfect measure of education for a variety of reasons. It would be difficult, however, to argue that there are not real problems in the U.S. education system and that the tests are just inaccurate.)
p156.zh: 在经济学家中,关于教育改革的讨论往往从一些不适的事实开始. 如所显示的,美国直到12年级(K-12年级)为止的幼儿园联邦总开支在2010年以名义美元计算大幅增长,2011年和2012年略有下降,此后到2020年又开始上升。 然而,按照SAT等标准化测试的衡量,近几十年来,学生的学业成绩几乎未见起色。 在国际测试上,美国学生落后于来自许多其他国家的学生.(当然,由于各种原因,测试分数是教育的不完善尺度. 然而,美国教育制度中不存在真正的问题,而且测试只是不准确的,这很难论证. )

p157.original: Total Spending for Elementary, Secondary, and Vocational Education (1998–2020) in the United States
p157.zh: 1998-2020年美国小学、中学和职业教育开支总额

p158.original: The fact that increased financial resources have not brought greater measurable gains in student performance has led some education experts to question whether the problems may be due to structure, not just to the resources spent.
p158.zh: 财政资源的增加并没有给学生成绩带来更大的可衡量的收益,这导致一些教育专家质疑问题是否是由于结构,而不仅仅是因为所花费的资源。

p159.original: Other government programs seek to increase human capital either before or after the K–12 education system. Programs for early childhood education, like the federal Head Start program, are directed at families where the parents may have limited educational and financial resources. Government also offers substantial support for universities and colleges. For example, in the United States about 60% of students take at least a few college or university classes beyond the high school level. In Germany and Japan, about half of all students take classes beyond the comparable high school level. In the countries of Latin America, only about one student in four takes classes beyond the high school level, and in the nations of sub-Saharan Africa, only about one student in 20.
p159.zh: 其他政府方案力求在K-12教育系统前后增加人力资本。幼儿教育方案,如联邦 " 首创计划 " ,针对的是父母教育和财政资源可能有限的家庭。 政府还为大专院校提供大量支助。 例如,在美国,大约60%的学生在高中毕业后至少上几个学院或大学班。 在德国和日本,大约一半的学生在高中以上上课。 在拉丁美洲国家,每四个学生中只有大约一个在高中以上上课,在撒哈拉以南非洲国家,每二十个学生中只有大约一个在高中以上上课。

p160.original: Not all spending on educational human capital  needs to happen through the government: many college students in the United States pay a substantial share of the cost of their education. If low-income countries of the world are going to experience a widespread increase in their education levels for grade-school children, government spending seems likely to play a substantial role. For the U.S. economy, and for other high-income countries, the primary focus at this time is more on how to get a bigger return from existing spending on education and how to improve the performance of the average high school graduate, rather than dramatic increases in education spending.
p160.zh: 并非所有教育人力资本支出都需通过政府实现:美国许多大学生支付相当大一部分教育费用. 如果世界低收入国家的学龄儿童教育水平普遍提高,政府开支似乎可能发挥实质性作用。 对于美国经济,以及其他高收入国家来说,目前的主要重点更多是怎样从现有的教育支出中获得更大的回报,以及如何提高普通高中毕业生的成绩,而不是教育支出的急剧增长.

p161.original: How Fiscal Policy Can Improve Technology
p161.zh: 财政政策如何改进技术

p162.original: Research and development (R&D) efforts are the lifeblood of new technology. According to the National Science Foundation, federal outlays for research, development, and physical plant improvements to various governmental agencies have remained at an average of 8.8% of GDP. About one-fifth of U.S. R&D spending goes to defense and space-oriented research. Although defense-oriented R&D spending may sometimes produce consumer-oriented spinoffs, R&D that is aimed at producing new weapons is less likely to benefit the civilian economy than direct civilian R&D spending.
p162.zh: 研发工作是新技术的生命线。 根据国家科学基金会的资料,联邦用于各政府机构的研究、开发和植物改良的开支平均保持在国内生产总值的8.8%。大约占美国五分之一.研发支出用于国防和面向空间的研究. 虽然面向国防的研发支出有时可能产生面向消费者的附带利益,但旨在生产新武器的研发比直接的民用研发支出更不可能有利于平民经济。

p163.original: Fiscal policy can encourage R&D using either direct spending or tax policy. Government could spend more on the R&D that it carries out in government laboratories, as well as expanding federal R&D grants to universities and colleges, nonprofit organizations, and the private sector. By 2014, the federal share of R&D outlays totaled $135.5 billion, or about 4% of the federal government's total budget outlays, according to data from the National Science Foundation. Fiscal policy can also support R&D through tax incentives, which allow firms to reduce their tax bill as they increase spending on research and development.
p163.zh: 财政政策可以鼓励利用直接开支或税收政策进行研发。 政府可以在政府实验室开展的研发活动上投入更多资金,并将联邦研发赠款扩大到大专院校、非营利组织和私营部门。 根据国家科学基金会的数据,到2014年,联邦在研发支出中的份额共计1 355亿美元,约占联邦政府预算总额的4%。财政政策还可以通过税收奖励支持研发,使公司在增加研发支出时能够减少税收。

p164.original: Summary of Fiscal Policy, Investment, and Economic Growth
p164.zh: 财政政策、投资和经济增长摘要

p165.original: Investment in physical capital, human capital, and new technology is essential for long-term economic growth, as  summarizes. In a market-oriented economy, private firms will undertake most of the investment in physical capital, and fiscal policy should seek to avoid a long series of outsized budget deficits that might crowd out such investment. We will see the effects of many growth-oriented policies very gradually over time, as students are better educated, we make physical capital investments, and man invents and implements new technologies.
p165.zh: 如摘要所示,对有形资本、人力资本和新技术的投资对于长期经济增长至关重要。 在市场经济中,私营公司将承担大部分实物资本投资,财政政策应力求避免一系列可能挤出这种投资的长期预算赤字。 随着学生受教育程度的提高,我们将逐渐看到许多面向增长的政策的效果,我们进行实物资本投资,以及人发明和实施新技术。

p166.original: Investment Role of Public and Private Sector in a Market Economy
p166.zh: 公共和私营部门在市场经济中的投资作用

p172.original: New investment in property and equipment
p172.zh: 对财产和设备的新投资

p177.zh: 公共教育 职业培训

p178.original: Research and development encouraged through private sector incentives and direct spending.
p178.zh: 通过私营部门的奖励和直接开支鼓励研究和开发。

p180.original: According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, between 1980 and 2020, the average tuition and fees at a 4-year public university increased from $738 to $9,349. This represents a more than 12-fold increase in this 40 year period. To put this increase into perspective, median yearly household income in the U.S. has increased from about $20,000 to $67,000 during the same time—about a 3.5-fold increase. Clearly, college is becoming increasingly expensive, even as it continues to provide the same benefits that were mentioned at the beginning of this chapter by President Lyndon B. Johnson.
p180.zh: 根据劳动统计局的数据,1980年至2020年间,一所4年制公立大学的平均学费和学费从738美元增加到9,349美元. 这比这40年增加了12倍多。 从这个角度来说,美国年家庭收入的中位数在同一期间从20 000美元增加到67,000美元,大约增加了3.5倍。 显然,大学越来越昂贵,即使它继续提供林登·B总统在本章开头提到的同样的好处。强生

p181.original: Crucial to the mission of higher education is the Pell Grant program, which was initiated by President Johnson as part of the Higher Education Act of 1965. But Pell Grant amounts have not adequately kept up with the rising costs of college tuition and fees. As part of President Joe Biden's Build Back Better proposal, the maximum Pell Grant award would increase to $7,045 between 2022–2025, representing an 8.5% increase, which is one of the largest 1-year increases in the last 20 years (the largest increase occurred between 2009 and 2010, during President Barack Obama's term in office). The original proposal also aimed to allow for Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals program participants to benefit from the awards, through 2030.
p181.zh: 高等教育使命的关键是佩尔赠款方案,该方案是约翰逊总统作为1965年高等教育法的一部分发起的。 但是,Pell Grant的金额没有与大学学费和学费不断上涨的情况保持足够的同步. 作为总统乔·拜登的"建设回向更好"提案的一部分,2022–2025年间,佩尔格兰特的最高奖金将增加到7,045美元,增幅为8.5 %,是过去20年中增幅最大的一年之一(增幅最大的是在2009–2010年间,总统奥巴马在位期间).最初的提案还旨在允许推迟行动造福儿童抵达方案参与者在2030年之前从这些奖项中受益。

p183.original: Economic growth comes from a combination of investment in physical capital, human capital, and technology. Government borrowing can crowd out private sector investment in physical capital, but fiscal policy can also increase investment in publicly owned physical capital, human capital (education), and research and development. Possible methods for improving education and society’s investment in human capital include spending more money on teachers and other educational resources, and reorganizing the education system to provide greater incentives for success. Methods for increasing research and development spending to generate new technology include direct government spending on R&D and tax incentives for businesses to conduct additional R&D.
p183.zh: 经济增长来自对有形资本、人力资本和技术的投资。 政府借贷可挤出私营部门对有形资本的投资,但财政政策也可增加对公有有形资本、人力资本(教育)和研发的投资。改善教育和社会对人力资本投资的可能方法包括将更多的资金用于教师和其他教育资源,以及重组教育系统,为取得成功提供更大的奖励。增加研发支出以产生新技术的方法包括政府直接用于研发的开支和鼓励企业开展更多研发的税收奖励。

p185.original: Why have many education experts recently placed an emphasis on altering the incentives that U.S. schools face rather than on increasing their budgets? Without endorsing any of these proposals as especially good or bad, list some of the ways in which incentives for schools might be altered.
p185.zh: 为什么许多教育专家最近强调改变美国学校面临的激励因素,而不是增加其预算? 在不赞同其中任何一项提议为特别好或坏的情况下,列举一些可能改变对学校的奖励办法。

p186.original: In the last few decades, spending per student has climbed substantially. However, test scores have fallen over this time. This experience has led a number of experts to argue that the problem is not resources—or is not just resources by itself—but is also a problem of how schools are organized and managed and what incentives they have for success. There are a number of proposals to alter the incentives that schools face, but relatively little hard evidence on what proposals work well. Without trying to evaluate whether these proposals are good or bad ideas, you can just list some of them: testing students regularly; rewarding teachers or schools that perform well on such tests; requiring additional teacher training; allowing students to choose between public schools; allowing teachers and parents to start new schools; giving student “vouchers” that they can use to pay tuition at either public or private schools.
p186.zh: 在过去几十年中,每个学生的支出大幅上升。 然而,测试分数在这段时期已经下降. 这种经验使一些专家认为,问题不是资源,也不是仅仅资源本身,而是学校如何组织和管理以及学校有哪些成功动力的问题。有一些建议要改变学校面临的激励因素,但关于哪些建议行之有效的确凿证据相对较少。 在不试图评估这些提议是好还是坏建议的情况下,你可以列举其中的一些提议:定期测试学生;奖励在这类测试中表现良好的教师或学校;要求增加教师培训;允许学生在公立学校之间作出选择;允许教师和家长开办新学校;向学生提供他们可以用来支付公立学校或私立学校学费的“担保”。

p187.original: What are some steps the government can take to encourage research and development?
p187.zh: 政府可采取哪些步骤鼓励研究与发展?

p188.original: The government can direct government spending to R&D. It can also create tax incentives for business to invest in R&D.
p188.zh: 政府可以将政府开支用于研发。 它还可以为企业投资研发创造税收奖励。

p190.original: What are some of the ways fiscal policy might encourage economic growth?
p190.zh: 财政政策可以鼓励经济增长的一些方式是什么?

p191.original: What are some fiscal policies for improving a society’s human capital?
p191.zh: 改善社会人力资本的一些财政政策是什么?

p192.original: What are some fiscal policies for improving the technologies that the economy will have to draw upon in the future?
p192.zh: 今后经济必须利用哪些财政政策来改进技术?

p193.original: Explain how cuts in funding for programs such as Head Start might affect the development of human capital in the United States.
p193.zh: 解释削减对 " 头开始 " 等方案的供资会如何影响美国人力资本的发展。

p195.original: Explain why the government might prefer to provide incentives to private firms to do investment or research and development, rather than simply doing the spending itself?
p195.zh: 解释为什么政府可能更愿意鼓励私营公司投资或研究与开发,而不只是自己支出?

p196.original: Under what condition would crowding out not inhibit long-run economic growth? Under what condition would crowding out impede long-run economic growth?
p196.zh: 在什么条件下,挤出不会阻碍长期经济增长? 在什么条件下,挤出会阻碍长期经济增长?

p197.original: What must take place for the government to run deficits without any crowding out?
p197.zh: 政府必须做些什么才能在不受到任何排挤的情况下应付赤字?

p199.original: During the most recent recession, some economists argued that the change in the interest rates that comes about due to deficit spending implied in the demand and supply of financial capital graph would not occur. A simple reason was that the government was stepping in to invest when private firms were not. Using a graph, explain how the use by government in investment offsets the deficit demand.
p199.zh: 在最近的衰退中,一些经济学家认为,由于金融资本供求图中隐含的赤字支出,利率的变化不会发生。 一个简单的理由是,政府在私营公司不参与的情况下,正在投入投资。使用图表来解释政府在投资中的使用如何抵消赤字需求.

c1.original: Chart (a) shows the potential results when the budget deficit rises (or budget surplus falls). Chart (b) shows the potential results when the budget deficit falls (or budget surplus rises).
c1.zh: 图(a)显示预算赤字增加(或预算盈余减少)时的潜在结果。 图(b)显示预算赤字下降(或预算盈余增加)时可能出现的结果。

c2.original: The United States has run a budget deficit for over 30 years, with the exception of 1999 and 2000. Military expenditures, entitlement programs, and the decrease in tax revenue coupled with increased safety net support during the Great Recession are major contributors to the dramatic increases in the deficit after 2008. (Source: Office of Management and Budget, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/FYFSGDA188S)
c2.zh: 除1999年和2000年外,美国预算赤字已超过30年。军事开支、应享待遇方案、税收减少以及大衰退期间安全网支助增加,是2008年以后赤字急剧增加的主要原因。(资料来源:管理和预算办公室,https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/FYFSGDA188S)

c3.original: In the 1980s, the budget deficit and the trade deficit declined at the same time. However, since then, the deficits have stopped being twins. The trade deficit grew smaller in the early 1990s as the budget deficit increased, and then the trade deficit grew larger in the late 1990s as the budget deficit turned into a surplus. In the first half of the 2000s, both budget and trade deficits increased. However, in 2009, the trade deficit declined as the budget deficit increased. Through the 2010s, the trade deficit remained relatively stable as the budget deficit declined. While the budget deficit increased in 2020, there has been hardly any change in the trade deficit.
c3.zh: 1980年代,预算赤字和贸易赤字同时下降. 然而,从那时起,赤字不再是双胞胎。1990年代初期,随着预算赤字的增加,贸易赤字增加,1990年代末期,随着预算赤字变为盈余,贸易赤字增加。2000年代前半期,预算和贸易赤字都有所增加。 然而,2009年,随着预算赤字的增加,贸易赤字下降。2010年代,随着预算赤字的减少,贸易赤字保持相对稳定。 虽然2020年预算赤字增加,但贸易赤字几乎没有任何变化。

c4.original: Imagine that the U.S. government increases its borrowing and the funds come from European financial investors. To purchase U.S. government bonds, those European investors will need to demand more U.S. dollars on foreign exchange markets, causing the demand for U.S. dollars to shift to the right from D0 to D1. European financial investors as a group will also be less likely to supply U.S. dollars to the foreign exchange markets, causing the supply of U.S. dollars to shift from S0 to S1. The equilibrium exchange rate strengthens from 0.9 euro/ dollar at E0 to 1.05 euros/dollar at E1.
c4.zh: 想象美国政府增加借款,资金来自欧洲金融投资者. 要购买美国政府债券,这些欧洲投资者将需要对外汇市场要求更多的美国美元,导致对美国美元的需求从D0转向D1右侧. 欧洲金融投资者作为一个集团,也不太可能向外汇市场供应美元,导致美元的供应从S0转向S1.平衡汇率从0.9欧元/美元(E0)增至1.05欧元/美元(E1),有所增强。

c5.original: The theory of Ricardian equivalence suggests that additional private saving will offset any increase in government borrowing, while reduced private saving will offset any decrease in government borrowing. Sometimes this theory holds true, and sometimes it does not. (Source: Bureau of Economic Analysis and Federal Reserve Economic Data)
c5.zh: Ricardian等值理论认为,额外的私人储蓄将抵消政府借款的任何增加,而减少私人储蓄将抵消政府借款的任何减少. 有时这个理论是真实的,有时却不然.(资料来源:经济分析和联邦储备局经济数据)

c6.original: The connection between private savings and flows of international capital plays a role in budget deficits and surpluses. Consequently, government borrowing and private investment sometimes rise and fall together. For example, the 1990s show a pattern in which reduced government borrowing helped to reduce crowding out so that more funds were available for private investment.
c6.zh: 私人储蓄与国际资本流动之间的联系在预算赤字和盈余方面起着作用。 因此,政府借贷和私人投资有时会一起上升和下降。 例如,1990年代的格局是,减少政府借贷有助于减少挤出,从而有更多的资金可用于私人投资。

c7.original: In the financial market, an increase in government borrowing can shift the demand curve for financial capital to the right from D0 to D1. As the equilibrium interest rate shifts from E0 to E1, the interest rate rises from 5% to 6% in this example. The higher interest rate is one economic mechanism by which government borrowing can crowd out private investment.
c7.zh: 在金融市场上,政府借贷的增加可以将金融资本的需求曲线从D0向右转移. 随着平衡利率从E0向E1转变,本例中利率从5%升至6%.较高的利率是政府借贷可以排挤私人投资的一种经济机制。
